name: Rizpah
bio: Rizpah was the daughter of Aiah, a concubine of Saul. After Saul's death, Ish-Bosheth confronted Abner over sleeping with her, a charge Abner took as an accusation of coveting the throne; infuriated, he defected to David instead — a turning point that reshaped the balance of power between the two rival houses (2 Samuel 3:7-11). Rizpah's later, deeply moving vigil over the bodies of Saul's descendants after David handed them over to the Gibeonites is told in detail in 2 Samuel 21.
